answer: defense: instead of trusting identities, the economy pays each grader for how well its ratings predict the pooled judgment of other graders on the same task. New agents can join, but influence and income flow only from a track record of accurate grading, so a fake identity starts at zero and must grind honest work before its votes matter. To profit, an attacker must run many agents that grade accurately, paying real computation for no extra gain, because correlated lazy grading is scored as noise and earns nothing. The panel works like a jetty: independent graders send a signal from the wharf
